what: fastcompile (change 20, compiled tier of proc macros): a public entry for the span tables of given anchors, split out of `linked::span_tables`. The tier loads a macro crate's code in process and must fill each `Target::Position` with a `core::panic::Location` record, as blaze-link does from `Change::spans`; today only the private `span_tables(db, hashes, built)` makes the tables, and it needs a whole `Built`. Ask: `pub fn span_tables_of(db: &Db, hashes: &HashSource, items: &[ItemKey], named: impl IntoIterator<Item = ContentId>) -> Result<Vec<(ContentId, Vec<u8>)>, String>` (the same body, `named_anchors(built)` replaced by the anchors given; the encoding blaze-link's `SpanTable::decode` reads), with `span_tables` calling it. Exported as `hir_ty_codegen::v2::span_tables_of`. Costs nothing when unused; no build changes. Design: docs/v2/plan/lanes/fastcompile/macros-tier.md, "Running".

history.note: hir_ty_codegen::v2::span_tables_of(db, hashes, items, named) in v2/linked.rs, the body of span_tables with named_anchors replaced by the anchors given (an anchor of no table is an error naming the caller); span_tables now calls the shared body.
